configuration.title: Cursor Accounts
configuration.refresh.enabled.descriptio: Automatically refresh quota data from Cursor.
configuration.statusBar.showIncluded.des: Show included quota usage progress in the status bar.
configuration.statusBar.showTotal.descri: Show total plan usage percentage in the status bar.
configuration.statusBar.showAccountEmail: Append logged-in email (read from local Cursor auth cache) to tooltips.
configuration.profiles.autoDetectRunning: Automatically detect running Cursor instances for each profile.
configuration.profiles.showProfileInStat: Show current profile name in the status bar.
configuration.profiles.refreshAllInterva: Interval in seconds for refreshing all profile quotas.
configuration.profiles.instanceDetection: Interval in seconds for detecting running Cursor instances.
configuration.modelEfficiency.showNotifi: Show an information notification when model efficiency severity is high.
configuration.modelEfficiency.autoShowOu: Automatically open the Model Efficiency output channel on each analysis.
configuration.modelEfficiency.pollInterv: Interval in seconds for polling the profile state.vscdb for new Composer user messages (5–60).
configuration.debug.webviewLifecycle.des: Log webview lifecycle diagnostics to the Cursor Accounts output channel (disable after troubleshooting).
configuration.debug.showActiveConversati: Show the focused Composer chat ID (lastFocusedComposerIds) in the status bar for development and testing.
configuration.debug.activeConversationPo: Polling interval in milliseconds for detecting Composer tab focus changes (100–5000).
configuration.proxy.enabled.description: Start the MITM proxy when the extension activates (observes Cursor network traffic).
configuration.proxy.port.description: TCP port for the local MITM proxy (localhost only).
configuration.proxy.maxLogSizeMB.descrip: Maximum total size of proxy log files and spilled body files in megabytes.
configuration.proxy.maxBodyLogMB.descrip: Maximum request/response body size stored inline in each JSONL line. Larger bodies are saved under logs/bodies/ when spill is enabled.
configuration.proxy.spillLargeBodies.des: When a body exceeds the inline limit, save the full raw bytes to logs/bodies/ instead of truncating (recommended for analysis).
When launching a profile, route traffic through the proxy if it is running.
configuration.proxy.logTrafficToOutput.d: Write intercepted proxy traffic to the Cursor MITM Proxy output channel.
configuration.proxy.autoShowOutputChanne: Automatically open the Cursor MITM Proxy output channel when the proxy starts.
configuration.proxy.outputCursorHostsOnl: Only log Cursor host traffic (cursor.sh, cursor.com) in the MITM Proxy output channel.
When opening the MITM Proxy output channel, replay recent lines from the active log file.
configuration.proxy.showLiveUsageInStatu: Show live agent/chat token usage in the status bar while the MITM proxy is running (updates from proxy IPC traffic, not log files).
configuration.proxy.estimatedDollarsPerM: Rough USD per million tokens for live cost estimates in the status bar (actual billing may differ).
configuration.proxy.trafficDiagnostics.d: Emit periodic [ProxyDiagnostics] summaries in the MITM output channel (CONNECT hosts, Agent RPC counts, bypass hints). Helps detect traffic that never hits the proxy.
configuration.proxy.diagnosticsIntervalM: Interval in milliseconds between [ProxyDiagnostics] summaries in the MITM output channel.
configuration.proxy.logTokenDetectorToOu: Write agent/token/conversation events from proxy IPC to the Cursor Token Detector output channel.
configuration.proxy.autoShowTokenDetecto: Automatically open the Cursor Token Detector output channel when agent or token events arrive.
